profile_text.body:
Adobe is a for-profit public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, with ticker symbol ADBE. Its most recent 10-K filing, covering the period ending November 28, 2025, reported revenue of $23,769,000,000. The company's website, focused on Adobe Express, describes it as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool for creating social content, videos, logos, and more, with an AI Assistant that the site says allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements across layers.

Adobe tracks several AI products across multiple categories. Adobe Express AI is described as a lightweight design tool with quick content creation capabilities and integration with Adobe Firefly, which is a separate image generation product the company characterizes as trained on commercially safe data. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video editing features including generative extend and color match, also marketed under a commercially safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI offers audio enhancement tools including speech enhancement and a microphone check feature, again with a commercially safe training claim attached.

The held facts include a CIK of 0000796343 on SEC records, consistent with Adobe's status as a publicly traded company. No litigation cases or MCP server entries are recorded in the current data.
